title: TensorPlate Scheduler Pressure Signal
description:
Memory- or thermal-pressure signal accepted by InferScheduler::on_pressure. Mirrors include/tensorplate/scheduler/pressure.hpp::PressureSignal.

Carriers MUST NOT include CUDA, NVML, TensorRT, Jetson, Vitis, XRT, DPU, or any other vendor SDK type. Memory pressure can be derived from V01-E03 BufferAccounting; thermal pressure can be produced by a runtime/device collector. v0.1.0 baseline policy records the most recent severity per source and may reject new admission when severity is at or above the configured pressure_reject_threshold; queued and in-flight work is never killed solely by a pressure signal.

source.description: Pressure source. Memory is produced from buffer-plane accounting; thermal is produced from a device-temperature collector (placeholder in v0.1.0).

timestamp_unix_nanos.description: Monotonic timestamp captured by the producer when the severity transitioned. Encoded as steady-clock time_since_epoch nanoseconds.
